READ-ONLY MAP. Both trees were checked on 2026-10-02. Standalone: C:/Users/zpull/BartendersLedger, on main, clean, level with origin/main at 1c33c00, ledger-v60. Suite: C:/Users/zpull/OutsideOfTime/ledger, at 40c19927a, oot-ledger-v88.

HOW THE UNIVERSE IS BUILT. tools/levels/lib.mjs universe() loads FILES in index.html order: data-core, data-ingredients, ingredients, engine, data-questions, data-lore, data-ontap, data-coffee, data-coffee-films, data-service, srs, ui-study, ui-practice, ui-reference, ui-prep, ui-new. It does this through tools/load-wing.mjs, which honours LEDGER_JS. Each item becomes a row {key, name, kind, sub, metable, fixed?, signals}. Rows run through KEY_ALIAS, which maps the wing's key to the standalone's key. There are 1,150 rows. Only cards, questions and drills are met-able.

BAR MANAGER NOW (level 4): 97 items, 84 of them met-able.
- cocktails 52: 48 cards and 4 riffs. Books: Obscura 29, Golden Age 8, Dessert/Hot/After-Dinner 7, Frozen 4. All 10 families appear: S&V 17, Egg & Cream 8, Sour 6, Old Fashioned 5, Hot 3, Highball 3, Julep 2, Punch 2, Tiki 1, Duo & Trio 1.
- shots 4: Flaming Sambuca, Flaming Lamborghini, Blue Blazer Shot, Zero Proof Sekanjabin.
- ontap 17: 5 cards (Rauchbier, New England Style, Ice Cider, Koshu, Taruzake), 10 questions (about 6 on cellar and condition, about 4 on brewing), and sections sec:ontap/cellar and sec:ontap/brewing.
- coffee 5: AeroPress, White Tea, Stale, Scale and water, and sec:coffee/faults.
- technique 2: two questions (dilution, washed-out tiki).
- spirits 4: three questions (NOM, Chartreuse 2023, cask share) and prod:junipero-anchor.

- prep 7: two questions (batching water, syrup by weight) and the preps fat-washing, milk-washing-clarification, high-proof-tinctures, house-bitters, acid-adjusting.

KINDS, WITH THEIR FILE, VARIABLE, FIELDS, KEY AND ONE EXAMPLE.

1. Cocktail card. js/data-core.js COCKTAILS {name, tier, family, spirit, spec[], method, glass, garnish, note}. A story is required in js/data-lore.js as LORE["<name>"]. The key is the name. Example: {name:"Old Fashioned", tier:1, family:"Old Fashioned", spirit:"Whiskey", spec:["2 oz bourbon or rye",...], method:"Stir over ice", glass:"Rocks, large cube", garnish:"Expressed orange peel", note:"..."}.
   - tier is the key into TIER_NAMES, and BOOK_ORDER=[1,2,3,7,4,11,5,9,12,8,6,10] sets the reading order. Books 6 Golden Age, 8 Dessert, 10 Obscura and 12 Frozen are the Bar Manager books.
   - family must be one of 10 FAMILIES keys (FAMILIES carries formula, lesson, marks, fault).

2. Shot. js/ui-reference.js SHOTS {name, cat in SHOT_CATS, spec, method, note}. Key: 'Shots · '+name. Example: {name:"Flaming Sambuca", cat:"Flaming & Novelty", spec:["1.5 oz sambuca","3 coffee beans"], method:..., note:...}.

3. Zero proof. NA_DRINKS in the same file {name, cat in NA_CATS, spec, method, glass, garnish, why}. Key: 'Zero Proof · '+name. Example: Sekanjabin, cat "Global Refreshers".

4. On Tap card. js/data-ontap.js ONTAP_REF {dom in faults/styles/cider/sake (must be an ONTAP_STUDY key), name, cat, note, facts:[[label,text]]}. Key: 'On Tap · '+name. Example: {dom:"styles", name:"American Lager", cat:"Lager", facts:[["ABV","4.2-5.0%"],["Glass",...]]}.

5. Coffee card. js/data-coffee.js COFFEE_REF, same shape (dom in shot/milk/filter/leaf/faults). Key: 'Coffee · '+name. Example: {dom:"shot", name:"Espresso", cat:"Black", note, facts:[["Ratio",...]]}.

6. Question. KNOWLEDGE {q, options[4], a (index), explain, topic?}.
   - Where it lives: the base array is in data-core.js. KNOWLEDGE.push blocks are in data-questions.js (6 blocks), data-service.js:322 (wine/service) and data-ontap.js:527 (topic:"ontap").
   - Key: 'q:'+slugify(q).slice(0,64).
   - Topic decides the subsection, through topicOf in ui-study.js:747. 'ontap' files under ontap. 'service' or 'wine' files under stick. A stem starting "SCENARIO" counts as service. Anything else is craft, and the placement picks its sub from CRAFT_SUBS [cocktails, spirits, technique, prep, stick, coffee, shots].
   - Example: {q:"Roughly how much of a properly made cocktail is water from dilution?", options:[...], a:2, explain:"..."}.

7. Drill. js/engine.js DRILLS {id, name, unit, dir 'low'|'high', ready:{op 'lt'|'ge'|'order'|'whole', v}, desc, hidden?, pick?}. Key: 'drill:'+id. The sub comes from DRILL_SUB in lib.mjs (blind→spirits, garnish/mise→prep, everything else→technique). Example: {id:'strain', name:'Double-Strain Discipline', ready:{op:'lt',v:45}, desc:"...Under 45..."}.

8. Section (read only).
   - SERVICE_STUDY in js/data-service.js {key, title, rows:[[title, body]]}, plus SERVICE_REF cards {dom, name, cat, note, facts}, which are not placed. Keys: wine, law, register, conflict, glassware.
   - ONTAP_STUDY (11 sections) and COFFEE_STUDY (9 sections) have the same shape.
   - Keys: 'sec:service|ontap|coffee/'+key.
   - STUDY in data-core.js {title, rows}. Its key is 'sec:notes/'+slugify(title), and the title needs a NOTE_SUB entry in lib.mjs.

9. Producer. js/ui-reference.js PRODUCERS {name, cat in PROD_CATS, where, est, why, process, bar}. Key: 'prod:'+slug.

10. Flight. js/ui-practice.js FLIGHTS {name, cat, teaches, pours[], look, lesson}. Key: 'flight:'+slug.

11. Prep. js/ui-prep.js PREPS {name, cat in PREP_CATS, ratio, yield, steps[], keeps, uses, note}. Key: 'prep:'+slug.
   - PREP_LISTS rows are [title, items[]], key 'preplist:'.
   - PREP_SAFETY rows are [title, text], key 'prepsafe:'.

12. Plate. js/ui-new.js:407 PLATES {id, title, caption, svg}. Key: 'plate:'+id.

13. Riff frame. js/engine.js:395 RIFFS {fam, label, lines['2 oz [base]'...], slots{}, twists[]}. Key: 'riff:'+slug(label). Example: {fam:'Sour', label:'The Sour Frame', ...}. It is rendered with the critique, critiqueRiff and critiqueHTML in js/ui-new.js:1302. That critique has a math branch for exactly Sour, S&V, Old Fashioned and Highball, plus RIFF_GLASS (the same 4), RIFF_INGREDIENT_NOTES, RIFF_TWIST_NOTES and RIFF_NAME_BANKS.

NOT IN THE UNIVERSE, so they cannot be placed or doored from a level:
- the Tools panels in ui-practice.js: Pour Cost (costHTML), Spill Log (SPILL_REASONS), Open Bottles (BOTTLE_KINDS), Batching, Strength, Convert;

LEVEL MACHINERY:

- js/data-levels.js holds LEVEL_ITEMS[sub][level] and LEVEL_KEY_ALIAS. It is machine-written.

map.authoring:
COMMON PATH FOR EVERY KIND
1. Write the text once, without any em dash and without naming a person: name the work, the place and the year instead. Paste the same words into both trees, in the matching place. The standalone file is the CRLF copy for app/data-core/data-lore/srs/ui-study; the suite copy is LF. Do not copy whole files across except the identical ones listed in the content model: data-coffee.js, data-ingredients.js, the level tools, data-levels.js and levels.js.
2. Add one line to tools/levels/placements.json in both trees, identical:
   {"key":...,"level":4,"sub":...,"reason":"..."}
   The reason must be at least 12 characters. Order inside the file does not matter, because the emit follows universe order.
3. Run `node tools/levels/set-levels.mjs --emit` in one tree and copy js/data-levels.js to the other, or run it in each. The result must be byte-identical.
4. If the suite's wording changes a key (a question stem, a notes title or a prep name), add 'wingKey':'ledgerKey' to KEY_ALIAS in tools/levels/lib.mjs (both trees) and re-emit. LEVEL_KEY_ALIAS rides in data-levels.js. There are currently seven aliases.
5. Bump versions.
   - Standalone: `?v=N` on each changed script in index.html, then sw.js CACHE ledger-v60 to ledger-v61. check.mjs fails a committed asset change without a CACHE bump.
   - Suite: `?v=` past the wing's own numbers (they diverge; for example data-core is ?v=20 in the standalone and ?v=21 in the suite), then CACHE oot-ledger-v88 to oot-ledger-v89.
6. Run the gates in both trees, then in the suite run node .scripts/check-publish.mjs.

PER KIND

- Bar Manager cocktail:
  - data-core.js: add a COCKTAILS entry in its book's block (tier 6, 8, 10 or 12; never 1 to 3, which are fixed, and never placed at Barback).
  - data-lore.js: add LORE["exact name"]. check.mjs closes LORE and COCKTAILS over each other.
  - Every spec line must resolve in js/data-ingredients.js INGREDIENTS or NOTE_LINES (check-ingredients), and every strong line must carry an ABV (check-abv). Add new ingredient rows to data-ingredients.js; it is identical in both trees.
  - The family must keep FAMILIES' marks true (check.mjs).
  - The suite's note and lore years must agree (check-years, which exists only in the suite).
  - Then the placement with sub "cocktails".
  - Re-check BOOK_ORDER: the books' mean levels now run Drinks of the World 2.750, Frozen 2.769, Dessert 2.818, Golden Age 3.200, Obscura 3.763. A single Bar Manager drink added to Frozen & Blended makes it 2.857 and fails check-levels until 12 and 8 are swapped in BOOK_ORDER, in data-core.js, in both trees.
  - The name is the SRS primary key: never rename a drink.

- Shot or zero-proof drink: ui-reference.js SHOTS or NA_DRINKS (both trees). Spec lines go through check-ingredients and check-abv. Placement sub "shots".

- On Tap card: data-ontap.js ONTAP_REF, with dom naming an ONTAP_STUDY key (check.mjs). Placement sub "ontap".
  - On Tap question: KNOWLEDGE.push block at data-ontap.js:527, with topic:"ontap".
  - On Tap section: ONTAP_STUDY {key, title, rows}. Key 'sec:ontap/<key>'.

- Coffee card or section: data-coffee.js only. Write it once and copy the file, since it is identical.
  - COFFEE_REF needs a dom naming a COFFEE_STUDY key.
  - Do not rename an existing row title: data-coffee-films.js is keyed sec + slugify(rowTitle), is machine-written, and check.mjs fails an orphaned film or a hand edit.
  - Coffee question: none exist anywhere today. Two ways to add one:
    - Option A: KNOWLEDGE.push with topic:"craft" and placement sub "coffee" (allowed by CRAFT_SUBS). Side effect: it also deals in the "Spirits & craft" quiz mode.
    - Option B: a new topic 'coffee'. This touches the four sites that must change together (topicOf, knowledgeByTopic, the array in spreadKnowledge, QUIZ_MODES in ui-study.js) plus lib.mjs universe(), which maps a topic to its sub.
  - A push placed in data-coffee.js stays byte-identical in both trees.

- Craft, service or wine question:
  - Craft goes in data-questions.js, or data-core.js KNOWLEDGE.
  - Service and wine go in the data-service.js:322 block, with topic:"service" or "wine". Both of those topics file under stick automatically.
  - Craft needs a sub from CRAFT_SUBS in its placement.
  - Exactly 4 options. Keep the key from being the longest option (check-options). The first 64 slug characters must be unique, or lib.mjs throws "two items share the key".
  - Editing a stem later changes its key, which orphans the placement and progress.qa.

- Drill: engine.js DRILLS (both trees). The desc must state the ready figure (check-levels). DRILL_SUB in lib.mjs if it is not technique. Placement "drill:<id>".

- Stick section:
  - data-service.js SERVICE_STUDY {key, title, rows}, optionally SERVICE_REF cards with dom=key.
  - Add the chip label to DOM_LABEL in ui-new.js:368 renderService; without it the chip shows the title.
  - Key 'sec:service/<key>'. The title must be dash-free (check-home scans level pages for an em dash).

- Notes section: data-core.js STUDY {title, rows}, plus NOTE_SUB[title] in lib.mjs (else universe() throws), plus KEY_ALIAS if the suite's title differs.

- Producer, flight, prep or plate:
  - Producer: PRODUCERS in ui-reference.js.
  - Flight: FLIGHTS in ui-practice.js.
  - Prep: PREPS, PREP_LISTS or PREP_SAFETY in ui-prep.js.
  - Plate: PLATES in ui-new.js.
  - Keys use the prefixes from the content model. The read door resolves by prefix in levels.js readDoorTarget.

- Riff frame:
  - engine.js RIFFS: append, because the frame is chosen by array index in app.js:441.
  - In ui-new.js add a frame.fam math branch in critiqueRiff, plus RIFF_GLASS[fam]. Without the glass entry it falls back to the Sour coupe.
  - Add matching RIFF_INGREDIENT_NOTES and RIFF_TWIST_NOTES regexes.
  - If a new base is used, extend baseSpirit in engine.js.
  - Placement 'riff:'+slugify(label), sub cocktails.

- A new script file: add it to index.html, sw.js ASSETS (check.mjs compares both directions) and lib.mjs FILES, in both trees.

LANDING
Standalone: commit to main and push to origin (GitHub BartendersLedger).

Suite: the checkout is on branch codex/teaching-atlas, at the same commit as main. It carries ChatGPT's uncommitted work in codex/* and in .scripts/check-publish.mjs and .scripts/publish.mjs. OutsideOfTime has no git remote. Live deploy goes through _publish (origin zpullen98-gif.github.io, head c8d7e31a). Per memory, use a detached worktree or clone of _publish, a plain `git push origin main`, and never `git add -A` before publish.mjs prints its staged-files line.

Record the new sync base, because CLAUDE.md's "currently d0175e6" is stale; the last wing sync carried 1c33c00.

map.risks:
- **BOOK_ORDER trap.** One new Bar Manager drink in Frozen & Blended (mean 2.769 against Dessert's 2.818) fails check-levels until 12 and 8 are swapped in BOOK_ORDER in data-core.js, in both trees. A move that raises Dessert past Golden Age's 3.200 would need the same.
- **Supply floor.** Moving any one of the at-floor level-4 questions (spirits, technique, stick, prep) or shot cards down fails SUPPLY. Add before you move anything.
- **Keys are identities.** A question key is the first 64 slug characters of its stem, and a card key is its name. Editing a stem or renaming a drink orphans its placement and wipes progress.qa and the SRS records.
  - Two stems that share a 64-character prefix make lib.mjs throw.
  - If the suite's wording differs (no person named), KEY_ALIAS must map it in lib.mjs, which is identical in both trees, followed by a re-emit.
- **Two trees, two texts.** About 15 js files differ, so a patch cannot be copied file to file except the identical ones (data-coffee, data-ingredients, ingredients, data-levels, levels, tools/levels, most of tools/check-*).
  - The standalone keeps em dashes freely (thousands of them).
  - The suite has 0 em dashes in ledger/, and the whole published suite has 1 dash of headroom (10 of 11).
  - En dashes do exist in the suite's specs (about 70 lines). The brief's claim that the suite carries "no em or en dash" is true only for em dashes.
  - Nothing automated checks for a named person, and the suite's engine.js:196 comment still says "(the DeGroff correction)".
- **Line endings.** Standalone app.js, data-core.js, data-lore.js, srs.js and ui-study.js are CRLF; the suite is LF. Edit anchors and byte comparisons must allow for it. check-levels normalises CRLF only for data-levels.js.
- **Suite checkout state.** OutsideOfTime is on branch codex/teaching-atlas, not main, though both point at 40c19927a. It carries ChatGPT's uncommitted codex/* work and modified .scripts/check-publish.mjs and .scripts/publish.mjs (about 243 lines). The memory rule is not to touch them, and that check-publish is the one which passed.
  - Ledger commits must avoid staging those files. Use a worktree off main or stage ledger/ explicitly.
  - OutsideOfTime has no remote, so "push everything" there means the _publish mirror. A separate worktree, C:/Users/zpull/OOT-canon-audit on canon-audit (918fb9685), holds the Codex audit and must not be disturbed.
- **Coffee questions.** Filed as topic craft, they leak into the "Spirits & craft" quiz mode. A new topic must change 4 sites together; missing spreadKnowledge makes a dead topic deal the whole bank silently.
- **Riff frames.** A new frame without RIFF_GLASS and a critique math branch gets the Sour coupe and no math note. Frames are chosen by array index, so append them and never reorder.
- **Read doors.** readDoorTarget opens only the first read item in a cell, so the order of the reads decides where Read goes. Any title shown on a level page must have no em dash in either tree (check-home).
- **Stale docs.** CLAUDE.md's sync base (d0175e6) and several prose counts are stale. Do not rely on them.
- **Not a gate.** check-films needs the network.

problems.fix: Cut the WS3 allergen and costing rows, since WS1 owns costing. Replace WS8's label row with one on bottled, kegged and clarified drinks (dairy, pressure and keeping time), and replace its label question.

problems.problem: The WS3 critique on a spec whose pour cost blows the target duplicates WS1's money questions.

WS5's program rows mostly repeat taught rows. Water and scale are in machine's 'Water, and the scale that kills machines'. Maintenance is in 'Backflushing...'. The dial-in routine is in shot's 'Dialling in, as a procedure'. Batch-brew holding is in filter's 'Batch brew is the one that pays'. Tea on the bar is in tea's 'Tea on a bar programme'.
problems.fix: Cut the section to 6 rows that only the person who runs the programme needs. Coffee chips show the section title (ui-coffee.js:19), so no label map is needed.

problems.problem: WS6 has overlaps and questions below the level. 'Additives and the Honest Blanco' is close to the blind-blanco well test and to the abocado question. 'Is Your Vermouth Dead?' is close to the vermouth flight. Rhum agricole's raw material is already a question. The Scotch youngest-age rule and the straight-whiskey age rule are Bartender-level facts.
problems.fix: Re-aim the flights. Replace the two below-level questions with buyer questions. The agricole question must test the AOC rules, not the cane.

problems.problem: WS7 leaves the 'count' drill's sub open, although DRILL_SUB is a plain map that check-levels reads through universe(), so 'count' can go to stick. The served-ABV-bands question tests material already taught at Barback (Technique: The Mechanics).
problems.fix: Set DRILL_SUB {count:'stick', batch:'prep'}. This gives level 4 stick its first drill and a Hands door. Replace the served-ABV question with one on carbonating a batched cocktail.

problems.problem: WS9 has two weak cards. 'Line infection' repeats the Diacetyl, Lactic and Acetic fault cards and the existing four-day butterscotch-or-vinegar question. A 'cellar' dom would pass check.mjs, but no card uses it today, and the renderer filters cards by section.
problems.fix: Keep five cards, using only the doms faults and styles.

problems.problem: Two of WS10's drinks are near-duplicates of existing cards: Baltimore Egg Nog of Eggnog and Glögg of Mulled Wine (both Barback). That is padding. Tiki drinks live in tier 5 (Tiki & Tropical) and others, so the rule 'only tiers 6/8/10' is not a model rule.
problems.fix: Drop both. Recompute the target book's mean against BOOK_ORDER for any tier.

problems.problem: Part of the standard is missing. Frozen & Blended (4 of 13 at Bar Manager; the standard leans it toward Bar Manager) has no review, and training the floor ('teach the three levels below') has no lesson.
problems.fix: Add WS12, a placement review with the owner's sign-off, and handle BOOK_ORDER. Fold training rows into the WS3 notes section.

problems.problem: The suite landing says 'fast-forward main', but the worktree must itself be on main; that is possible because main is checked out nowhere else. Books goes before edges only if it is appended first.
problems.fix: Append books, then edges. Run `git worktree add <path> main` and stage ledger/ only.

plan.summary:
This plan adds about 85 met-able Bar Manager units, taking level 4 from 84 to about 169, or about 179 with WS10, which waits on the owner. It also adds:
- 4 sections, 6 riff frames, 8 producers, 3 flights, 3 preps, 2 safety rows, 1 prep list and 3 drills;
- a level-4 'family from the spec' deal in the level test, written once in the byte-identical js/levels.js.

What I checked on 2026-10-02:
- Standalone 1c33c00 is clean.
- In the suite, ledger/ is clean. The checkout is on codex/teaching-atlas with ChatGPT's work.
- Line endings, from git ls-files --eol: standalone data-core.js is CRLF in the working tree. data-questions, data-coffee, data-levels and placements are LF in both trees.
- readDoorTarget always opens the Library for cocktails.
- check-options does not load data-coffee.js.
- DRILL_SUB is a plain map.
- Coffee chips show the section title. Service chips need DOM_LABEL (ui-new.js:368).
- RIFFS are picked by index (app.js:441).
- Overlaps were checked against every SERVICE, ONTAP and COFFEE row title and the relevant bank stems.

All new words are identical in both trees: no em or en dash, no ' -- ', no person named, and no KEY_ALIAS needed. Every question tests a lesson that sits at level 4 or a judgement only a Bar Manager makes. Refuter B names the lower item each builds beyond.

The bank grows from 292 to about 369, and the unique-longest gate to 47 (23 used in the standalone and 26 in the suite). New items aim for no more than 10 percent unique-longest keys.

Plates are left out; visual work belongs to ChatGPT.

Landing:
- one version bump at the end: ledger-v61 and oot-ledger-v89;
- the standalone main is pushed;
- the suite commits ledger/ from a worktree on main;
- _publish is reached through a clone, with a plain push;
- CLAUDE.md gets the new sync base.

Rows, from the manager's ledger, cross-referring to lower lessons:
1. Pour cost by category; one blended number lies. Build beyond 'BTG pricing isn't cocktail pour cost'.
2. Costing a spec to the cent: syrup, citrus yield, garnish.
3. Price from contribution margin.
4. The four quadrants of menu engineering.
5. The bottle book as perpetual inventory.
6. Tenths against weighing (tare and density); same counter, order, hour.
7. Par, reorder point and build-to for liquor and wine.
8. Usage against POS ideal. Build beyond register 'Variance'.
9. Reading variance line by line, theft last.
10. The spill log and the waste key.
11. Open-bottle dating as house policy; the shelf lives stay in Wine.
12. Keg yield and the cost of foam: money only, citing 'Keg sizes and what they yield'.
13. Comps and promotions as a named budget.
14. Receiving liquor and wine against the invoice: credit memo, FIFO.

Money questions (10): spec to percent; price to target; variance from opening/purchases/closing/POS; read a tenths count; keg foam loss in dollars; the menu-engineering grid; how a void and a comp move variance, beyond 'Void versus comp'; par from weekly usage; ring error before theft, distinct from the gin 12% scenario; margin dollars against percent.
Open-bottle questions (3, topic wine): fino or manzanilla; tawny against vintage port; Madeira. The vermouth and preservation questions are not repeated.
